## Description {#details}

<p>Deprecated literal operators and wrappers for typed operands.</p>


<p>Literals such as <span class="doxyComputerOutput">1<a href="#ga8468610e763177a8f569f7d618851288">_i</a></span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">42<a href="#ga231cd51e76a2f426703275739d605ad4">_f</a></span> create strongly typed operands, whilst wrappers like <span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::to_i{expression}</span> convert dynamic values, so that the (deprecated) overloaded operators can compare and report them.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Deprecated</dt>
<dd><p>The literals of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/literals">literals</a></span> namespace, the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">to_*</span> type wrappers, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/to-t">to_t</a>&lt;T&gt;</span>, and the two-argument <span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::approx (<a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/value">value</a>, epsilon)</span> are deprecated since 6.0.0, in favour of the function comparators <span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::eq()</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::ne()</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::lt()</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::le()</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::gt()</span>, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::ge()</span>, which compare and report the plain values, and of the function comparator <span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::approx (lhs, rhs, epsilon)</span>, which sets the tolerance explicitly. The compiler reports their use.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>The integer literals follow the C++ syntax: decimal, hexadecimal (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">0x10_i</span>), binary (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">0b101_i</span>), and octal (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">10<a href="#ga8468610e763177a8f569f7d618851288">_i</a></span>, which is 8), with digit separators (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">1'000<a href="#ga8468610e763177a8f569f7d618851288">_i</a></span>). A decimal point, an exponent, or a value that does not fit in the type of the literal (e.g. <span class="doxyComputerOutput">300<a href="#gaf27e37e2e29af1a3ffd5c4fb07e77ff9">_u8</a></span>) is a compilation error.</p>


<p>The floating-point literals are written with decimal digits and a decimal point, optionally with digit separators (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">1'000.000'5<a href="#ga7c6c0169d894a7dd589d96df49e8df26">_d</a></span>), but without an exponent; the digits before the decimal point, and the decimals, are each limited to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">std::numeric_limits&lt;T&gt;::digits10</span> of the type of the literal (for example 6 for <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#ga231cd51e76a2f426703275739d605ad4">_f</a></span> and 15 for <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#ga7c6c0169d894a7dd589d96df49e8df26">_d</a></span>), otherwise the compilation fails.</p>


<p>The literal <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"name"<a href="#gad4203783cfbe141f41ee8515f7b2ea94">_b</a></span> creates a named <span class="doxyComputerOutput">bool</span> constant with the value <span class="doxyComputerOutput">true</span>, reported by its name; it is deprecated in favour of a plain <span class="doxyComputerOutput">bool</span> and a check message.</p>


<p>The floating-point literals (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">1.5_d</span>) and wrappers (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::to_d{ 1.5 }</span>) compare with a tolerance of one unit of the last decimal written (0.1 for <span class="doxyComputerOutput">1.5</span>), so that <span class="doxyComputerOutput">1.45 == 1.5_d</span> is true. All six comparisons apply it consistently: values within the tolerance are equal, and neither less nor greater. Plain floating-point values compare exactly. The tolerance depends on the digits written, and on which operand is wrapped; to set it explicitly, use <span class="doxyComputerOutput">mt::approx (lhs, rhs, epsilon)</span>.</p>

<div class="doxyXrefSect">
<dl class="doxyXrefSectList">
<dt class="doxyXrefSectTitle"><a href=/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/pages/deprecated/#_deprecated000093>Deprecated</a></dt>

<p>This user-defined literal operator creates a named boolean constant, with the value <span class="doxyComputerOutput">true</span>, from a string literal (for example, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"feature_enabled"<a href="#gad4203783cfbe141f41ee8515f7b2ea94">_b</a></span>).</p>


<p>The returned <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/named-bool">detail::named_bool</a></span> converts implicitly to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">bool</span>, and the expression formatter prints its name instead of its value. With the operators in the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/operators">operators</a></span> namespace, a comparison like <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"feature_enabled"<a href="#gad4203783cfbe141f41ee8515f7b2ea94">_b</a> == flag</span> is true when <span class="doxyComputerOutput">flag</span> is true, and, when it fails, it is reported as <span class="doxyComputerOutput">feature_enabled == false</span>; the same applies to <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#gaa7c7b6a7ad32856edc235a05e77d8c7f">eq</a> ("feature_enabled"<a href="#gad4203783cfbe141f41ee8515f7b2ea94">_b</a>, flag)</span>. Without these operators, the comparison is a plain <span class="doxyComputerOutput">bool</span> expression, and its operands are not reported.</p>


<p>Definition at line <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/inlines/deprecated-inlines-h/#l00636">636</a> of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/inlines/deprecated-inlines-h">deprecated-inlines.h</a>.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Deprecated wrapping of a floating-point value with an explicit comparison tolerance.</p>


<p>The floating-point literals (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">1.5_d</span>) and wrappers (<span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#ga9608f4a6f0a61bc159a66a46fb8cd630">to_d</a>{ 1.5 }</span>) compare with a tolerance derived from the number of decimals written (0.1 for <span class="doxyComputerOutput">1.5</span>). <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#gafe47800a219b00fcccf0a1dc596dbe20">approx()</a></span> makes the tolerance explicit, independent of how the value is written. All six comparisons apply it: values whose difference is less than the tolerance are equal, and neither less nor greater. If both operands have a tolerance, the smaller one is used.</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">t.expect (mt::eq (compute_float (), mt::approx (42.0f, 0.001f)));</span></span></div>

</div>


<p>For a single comparison, also of integers, the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#gafe47800a219b00fcccf0a1dc596dbe20">approx</a> (lhs, rhs, epsilon)</span> function comparator may be used instead.</p>

<div class="doxySectionDef">

## Type Wrappers



<p>Strongly-typed wrappers for converting dynamic values and expressions to specific types recognised by µTest++ comparators.</p>


<p>These type aliases provide a type-safe mechanism for explicitly converting values to the required types for µTest++ test expressions and comparators. Each alias is a wrapper around <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/value">detail::value</a>&lt;T&gt;</span>, ensuring that the value is treated as the specified type within the framework.</p>


<p>The <span class="doxyComputerOutput">to_*</span> forms replaced the older <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#ga8468610e763177a8f569f7d618851288">_i</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#gaf27e37e2e29af1a3ffd5c4fb07e77ff9">_u8</a></span>, etc. aliases, which were deprecated in version 3.2.0.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Deprecated</dt>
<dd><p>Pass the plain values to the function comparators <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#gaa7c7b6a7ad32856edc235a05e77d8c7f">eq()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#ga5bf176ef730172592095657417e5f039">ne()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#ga9ae8e4747ff029faa7378110c8680278">gt()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#gab8da4228bc9a820546753b018a129a7e">ge()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#ga714ff07cd77e05898de4fd315770f901">lt()</a></span>, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#gae695dd46840f76a156aee70ff4df33fa">le()</a></span> instead; they report the operands in the same way. For the floating-point values compared with a tolerance, use <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#gafe47800a219b00fcccf0a1dc596dbe20">approx()</a></span> (since 6.0.0).</p></dd>
</dl>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Example</dt>
<dd></dd>
</dl>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">int</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> x = 42;</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment">// Explicitly treat x as an int for test comparison.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">auto</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> wrapped = <a href="#gaf3ee271cefcffa625e40d476305da62f">to_i</a>{x};</span></span></div>

</div>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Since</dt>
<dd><p>3.2.0</p></dd>
</dl>

<div class="doxySectionDef">

## Deprecated Type Wrappers



<p>The v5.0.1 names of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">to_*</span> type wrappers.</p>


<p>The Boost UT style names, with a leading underscore, kept for compatibility with the existing applications. Each one is an alias of the corresponding <span class="doxyComputerOutput">to_*</span> wrapper, so the wrapped values are compared and reported in the same way. They do not conflict with the literal operators with the same suffixes (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">42<a href="#ga8468610e763177a8f569f7d618851288">_i</a></span>), which are in the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/literals">literals</a></span> namespace.</p>


<p>GCC reports the deprecation only when the alias names the type of a declaration, not when it is used in an expression, as in <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#ga8468610e763177a8f569f7d618851288">_i</a> (expr)</span>; Clang reports it in both cases.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Deprecated</dt>
<dd><p>Pass the plain values to the function comparators <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#gaa7c7b6a7ad32856edc235a05e77d8c7f">eq()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#ga5bf176ef730172592095657417e5f039">ne()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#ga9ae8e4747ff029faa7378110c8680278">gt()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#gab8da4228bc9a820546753b018a129a7e">ge()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#ga714ff07cd77e05898de4fd315770f901">lt()</a></span>, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-function-comparators/#gae695dd46840f76a156aee70ff4df33fa">le()</a></span> instead; the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">to_*</span> type wrappers that replaced these aliases (since 3.2.0) are deprecated too (since 6.0.0).</p></dd>
</dl>
